title: People, Things, Places ve Teklifler
subtitle: Some-, any-, no- ve every- sözcüklerini günlük mesajlarda; kişi, şey ve yer anlatırken güvenle kullan.

learn.title: Aynı aile, üç farklı anlam
learn.intro: -one/-body kişi, -thing şey, -where ise yer anlatır. Cümlenin amacı hangi aileyi kullanacağını belirler.

cards.title: Some-: var ama belirsiz
cards.text: Olumlu bir bilgide someone/somebody, something ve somewhere kullan.
examples: I left my keys somewhere safe.

cards.title: Any-: açık soru veya olumsuzluk
cards.text: Genel sorularda ve not ile kurulan olumsuz cümlelerde anyone/anybody, anything ve anywhere kullan.

cards.title: No-: sıfır
cards.text: No one/nobody, nothing ve nowhere zaten olumsuz anlam taşır; ayrıca not kullanma.

cards.title: Every-: hepsi
cards.text: Everyone/everybody, everything ve everywhere tüm grubu, tüm şeyleri veya tüm yerleri kapsar.

cards.title: Tekil uyum
cards.text: Bu belirsiz sözcükler tekil kabul edilir.

learn.title: Gerçek soru mu, nazik teklif mi?
learn.intro: Sorunun amacı önemlidir: bilgi ararken any-, olumlu cevap beklenen teklif ve isteklerde some- doğal olabilir.

cards.title: Nazik teklif
cards.text: Bir şey sunarken something kullanabilirsin çünkü olumlu cevap beklenir.
examples: Would you like something to drink?
Can I get you something warm?

cards.title: Nazik istek
cards.text: Birinden belirli olmayan ama var olması beklenen bir şey isterken some- kullanımı doğaldır.
examples: Can I have something to write with?

cards.title: Çift olumsuz yok
cards.text: Not ile any- kullan veya no- sözcüğünü tek başına kullan; ikisini aynı cümlede birleştirme.

cards.title: Bağlama bak
cards.text: Tek bir sözcüğe değil, mesajın olumlu bilgi, soru, teklif, olumsuzluk veya tümünü kapsama amacı taşımasına bak.

read.title: The Neighbourhood Dinner
read.instructions: Etkinlik ekibinin bir sonraki adımı atmasına yardımcı olan cümlelere dokun.
read.selectionExplanation: Seçtiğin cümleler kimin yardıma ihtiyacı olduğunu, neyin eksik olduğunu veya nerede çözüm bulunduğunu açıkça gösteriyor.

tokens.text: Everyone in the neighbourhood received an invitation to Sunday dinner.
Someone called to ask for a vegetarian meal.
The organiser couldn't find the caller's name anywhere in her notes.
Nobody had written anything beside the phone number.
A volunteer suggested putting a message somewhere everybody would see it.
They posted the question at the entrance and online.

questions.prompt: What special request did the caller make?
questions.explanation: The second sentence states the request directly.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't the organiser contact the caller immediately?
questions.explanation: No name was written beside the phone number.

questions.prompt: Where did the team finally post its question?
questions.explanation: The final sentence names both places.

questions.prompt: Why did the volunteer choose visible places for the message?
questions.explanation: The volunteer wanted the message to reach the whole group.

extra.title: A Help Desk at the Street Fair
extra.instructions: Metni oku; kişileri, eşyaları ve yerleri gösteren ayrıntıları kullanarak cevapla.
paragraphs: At the street fair, everybody received a map at the entrance. The map showed food stalls, games and a small help desk. Someone had placed a box of umbrellas beside the desk so visitors could borrow one if it rained.

Around noon, a child said she could not find her family anywhere. A volunteer asked whether she remembered anything near their meeting point. The child remembered a red balloon and a music stand. The volunteer announced the details, and somebody from the music area replied immediately.

The family met at the help desk a few minutes later. Nothing was lost, and everyone felt relieved. Before leaving, the child's father offered the volunteers something to drink and thanked them for looking everywhere.

questions.prompt: What did visitors receive at the entrance?
questions.explanation: The first sentence gives this information.

questions.prompt: Why did someone put umbrellas near the help desk?
options: Visitors could borrow them if it rained
questions.answer: Visitors could borrow them if it rained
questions.explanation: The first paragraph states their practical purpose.

questions.prompt: Which two details helped locate the family?
options: A red balloon and a music stand
A food stall and a blue map
questions.answer: A red balloon and a music stand

questions.explanation: The second paragraph identifies the responder.

questions.prompt: What did the father offer the volunteers?
questions.explanation: The final sentence describes his offer.

listening.instructions: Her konuşmada ana durumu bul; ikinci dinlemede nothing, everything ve anything gibi sözcüklerin hangi ayrıntıya gönderme yaptığını not et.

exam.intro: Bu prova, kişi, şey ve yer bildiren belirsiz sözcükleri gerçek mesajlarda; özellikle soru, olumsuzluk, teklif ve isteklerde kullanmayı ölçer.

formats.title: Mesajları oku ve kanıtla cevapla
formats.instructions: Cevabını mesajdaki ayrıntıyla destekle. Model cevap olası doğru cevaplardan biridir.
passage: Nora: Is anyone free to help at the welcome desk from two to three? Someone has already covered the morning shift.
Kerem: I can help, but I need somewhere quiet to join a short call at 2:30. Is there anywhere near the desk?
Nora: Yes. The small office is available. Would you like something to drink before your shift? Everything in the kitchen is free for volunteers.

items.prompt: What help does Nora need?
items.answer: She needs someone at the welcome desk from two to three.
items.explanation: Her first message gives the role and exact time.

items.prompt: Why does Kerem need a quiet place?
items.answer: He has a short call at 2:30.
items.explanation: Kerem states the reason directly.

items.prompt: Where can Kerem take the call?
items.answer: He can use the small office.
items.explanation: Nora identifies the available room.

items.prompt: What does Nora offer Kerem?
items.answer: She offers him something to drink.
items.explanation: Her final message contains the offer.

items.prompt: Who may use the kitchen items?
items.explanation: Everything is free for volunteers, so the offer covers the whole volunteer group.
